name: speculateai
description: Assume an idea succeeds, trace second- and third-order effects, and identify the worst plausible downstream scenario.

interface.shortDescription: See what happens after your idea succeeds
interface.longDescription: A reflection-only tool that assumes an idea succeeds, traces plausible second- and third-order consequences, identifies the worst plausible downstream scenario without exaggeration, explains the causal chain, and asks one sharp question. It does not provide recommendations or solutions.
